# Numbers and dates test

The 1st argument is the path to the configuration file.

The 2nd parameter sets the timeout and the 3rd sets the retry count.

After the 4th attempt, the 5th retry triggers an alert.

The 6th field maps to the 7th column in the schema.

The 8th rule applies to the 9th and 10th entries.

The feature is planned for release in summer.

The API launched this spring and deprecates next fall.

Expect the patch in autumn or in winter at the latest.

The refactor happened last summer and finished this winter.

The team shipped the fix last spring and plans another next autumn.

The release date is 12/25/2024.

The deadline is 01-15-2025 or possibly 3.14.2025.
